users.name: Daichi Koga
users.introduction: Software Engineer with a Master's degree from the University of Tokyo and 3+ years of professional experience delivering enterprise systems across financial services, energy, government, and global B2B sectors. Hands-on across the full stack — from Java/Spring Boot and Vue/React applications to AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure — with a track record of taking ownership end-to-end, from requirements definition through production operation.

careers.detail: Lead a 2-person engineering team delivering cloud-based system integrations for domestic and international clients, serving as the primary technical point of contact. Designed and built secure AWS API infrastructure (authentication, rate limiting, audit logging), delivered tailored integrations such as PDF generation, inbound email ingestion, and bidirectional third-party APIs, and own IaC, CI/CD, monitoring, and cost optimization across AWS and GCP. Also drive technical pre-sales and consulting.

2024/01-2025/06: Developed and maintained customer information system features for the energy industry in Java with Oracle/MySQL, releasing roughly one feature per month from design through production, owning JP1 job scheduling and batch performance tuning. 2025/07-2026/02: Led cloud infrastructure design and provisioning on AWS for a large-scale public sector project, covering multi-environment build-out, disaster recovery and high-availability design, monitoring and alerting, and security hardening to meet strict compliance requirements.

Single-handedly owned 2 features end-to-end in parallel — requirements definition, design, implementation, and testing — for a customer information system in the securities industry, delivering at a pace of about 2 features per month. Worked across Vue.js, Spring Boot, SQL, AWS, and Oracle, engaging directly with business stakeholders.
